name: Communion
overview: The biblical concept of communion is deeply rooted in walking with God, as exemplified by Enoch and Noah who maintained close fellowship with Him (Genesis 5:22, 24; 6:9). This intimate relationship with God, initiated by divine commands such as those given to Abraham (Genesis 12:1), sets the foundation for the covenantal fellowship celebrated in the Lord's Supper. Communion, therefore, reflects both a remembrance of Christ's sacrificial death and an ongoing, personal walk with God, calling believers to live in obedience and fellowship with Him.
